## §0 GLOBAL NON-NEGOTIABLE SYSTEM INVARIANTS

### §0.1 Inherited Sprint 1–4 Invariants (ALL ACTIVE)

Sprint 5 code that violates **any** of these is categorically invalid regardless of functional correctness.

| ID         | Invariant                                                                            | Violation Signal                                         |
| ---------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | -------------------------------------------------------- |
| INV-1      | DB `$transaction` is the ONLY correctness authority                                  | Any business-critical multi-write outside `$transaction` |
| INV-2      | Inventory quantity NEVER goes negative                                               | `quantity - delta < 0` passes without rejection          |
| INV-3      | Atomic mutation bundle: quantity + movement + reservation + EventOutbox              | Any of these four written in separate operations         |
| INV-4      | Lock acquired BEFORE transaction, released AFTER commit                              | `reserve()` called inside `$transaction`                 |
| INV-5      | Optimistic locking `version` check mandatory on inventory mutations                  | `update` without `version` match                         |
| INV-6      | Idempotency key is the FIRST operation                                               | Any DB write before idempotency check                    |
| INV-7      | `InventoryMovement` is APPEND-ONLY — forever                                         | Any `update()` or `delete()` on InventoryMovement        |
| INV-8      | Redis is display optimization ONLY — never correctness authority                     | Redis miss causing 500 or data loss                      |
| INV-9      | Server-computed timestamps — never client-provided                                   | Any timestamp field set from request body                |
| INV-10     | Zero-oversell — enforced at DB layer                                                 | Stock going negative under concurrent load               |
| INV-11     | `consume()` receives `tx` from caller — NEVER opens its own `$transaction`           | `consume()` called without `tx` parameter                |
| INV-12     | No Razorpay/HTTP calls inside `$transaction`                                         | External HTTP inside `prisma.$transaction()`             |
| INV-13     | `OrderStatusHistory` is APPEND-ONLY — forever                                        | Any `update()` or `delete()` on OrderStatusHistory       |
| INV-14     | Order totals computed server-side from live DB prices                                | Client-provided price trusted                            |
| INV-15     | Webhook HMAC validated before any processing                                         | Signature check after any I/O                            |
| INV-16     | Payment idempotency check is FIRST operation                                         | DB write before idempotency check                        |
| INV-17     | EventOutbox dedup keys are deterministic                                             | `Date.now()`, `randomUUID()` in dedup key                |
| INV-18     | All cart/order/payment queries filter by userId/segment                              | Any query returning cross-user data                      |
| INV-19     | `order.status === 'PLACED'` checked INSIDE webhook `$transaction` before `consume()` | `consume()` without status check in same tx              |
| INV-20     | `eventVersion` + `schemaVersion` on EVERY EventOutbox record                         | EventOutbox.create() missing either field                |
| INV-21     | Rate-limit INCR+EXPIRE via atomic Lua script                                         | Two-command `INCR` + `EXPIRE` pattern                    |
| INV-22     | WebhookController responds within 5s                                                 | Synchronous I/O or heavy processing in webhook path      |
| INV-23     | `PaymentRetryExpiryWorker` cancels on BOTH Redis absent AND DB timestamp expired     | Redis-only cancellation check                            |
| INV-24     | Idempotency keys include `userId` from JWT — not client key alone                    | `payment_idem:{clientKey}` without userId                |
| INV-26     | COD `$transaction` includes synthetic `tx.payment.create()`                          | COD order without Payment record                         |
| INV-S3-ALL | All Sprint 3 InventoryService invariants active                                      | InventoryService bypassed                                |

| ID            | Invariant                                                                                                                                                                                                 | Enforcement Layer                                     |
| ------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------- |

Sprint 5 receives the following from Sprint 4 — these are verified as working and must not be broken:

| Element                     | Sprint 4 State                                                                         | Sprint 5 Action                                                           |
| --------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `OrderStateMachine`         | PROCESSING, SHIPPED, DELIVERED locked behind `SPRINT5_STATES` guard                    | REMOVE guard for PROCESSING and SHIPPED. Keep DELIVERED locked (Sprint 7) |
| `OrderItem.sellerId`        | Populated on all new creates from `Product.businessId`                                 | Sprint 5 seller views query by this field                                 |
| `OrderTracking`             | Table active in schema, empty                                                          | Seller fills `trackingNumber` + optional `dispatchProofUrl`               |
| `OrderStatusHistory`        | Append-only, Sprint 4 transitions recorded                                             | Sprint 5 adds CONFIRMED, PROCESSING, SHIPPED entries                      |
| `EventOutbox`               | `OrderCreated`, `OrderConfirmed`, `OrderCancelled`, `PaymentReceived`, `PaymentFailed` | Sprint 5 adds `OrderStatusChanged`, `SupplierScoreUpdated`                |
| `POST /payments/retry`      | Fully implemented with dual-authority window                                           | Sprint 5 adds `GET /payments/:orderId/retry-status` UI endpoint only      |
| `releaseAllForOrder()`      | Idempotent inventory release                                                           | Sprint 5 seller-cancel uses same API                                      |
| `PaymentProvider` interface | Abstracted — Razorpay + COD                                                            | No changes                                                                |

## §3 SCHEMA CHANGES & MIGRATIONS

All migrations MUST be applied in Phase 1, before any business logic phase. Running out of order causes runtime failures.

### §3.1 Required New Models

**MIGRATION S5-1: `SellerScore` table (INV-S5-16)**

```sql
CREATE TABLE "SellerScore" (
  "id"                     TEXT NOT NULL,
  "businessId"             TEXT NOT NULL,
  "compositeScore"         INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  "dispatchSpeedScore"     INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  "deliveryQualityScore"   INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  "acceptanceRate"         INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  "orderCount"             INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  "calculatedAt"           TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
  "previousCompositeScore" INTEGER,
  CONSTRAINT "SellerScore_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "SellerScore_businessId_key" UNIQUE ("businessId")
);
CREATE INDEX "idx_seller_score_biz" ON "SellerScore" ("businessId");
CREATE INDEX "idx_seller_score_composite" ON "SellerScore" ("compositeScore");
-- idx_seller_score_composite: Supports Sprint 7 Admin "show worst sellers" query
```

**MIGRATION S5-2: `OrderTracking` — add dispatch proof fields**

```sql
ALTER TABLE "OrderTracking" ADD COLUMN "dispatchProofUrl"  TEXT;
ALTER TABLE "OrderTracking" ADD COLUMN "dispatchProofAt"   TIMESTAMPTZ;
-- dispatchProofUrl: S3 HTTPS URL — NULL until seller uploads proof
-- dispatchProofAt: Upload confirmation timestamp — NULL until uploaded
```

**MIGRATION S5-3: Required index for KPI queries (INV-S5-14)**

```sql
-- Verify first: SELECT indexname FROM pg_indexes WHERE tablename = 'Order' AND indexname = 'idx_order_seller_stat';
-- If exists, skip. If not, add:
CREATE INDEX "idx_order_seller_date" ON "Order" ("sellerId", "createdAt");
-- This index is required for today's order count and revenue KPI queries
-- idx_order_seller_stat already covers (sellerId, status) — verify it exists from Sprint 4
```

**MIGRATION S5-4: Activate PROCESSING in `order-state-machine.ts`**

This is a code change, not a SQL migration. Remove `PROCESSING` and `SHIPPED` from `SPRINT5_STATES` guard in `order-state-machine.ts`. DELIVERED remains locked.

### §3.2 Prisma Schema Additions

Add to `schema.prisma`:

```prisma
model SellerScore {
  id                     String   @id @default(cuid())
  businessId             String   @unique
  compositeScore         Int      @default(0)  // 0-100
  dispatchSpeedScore     Int      @default(0)  // 0-100
  deliveryQualityScore   Int      @default(0)  // 0-100
  acceptanceRate         Int      @default(0)  // 0-100

  calculatedAt           DateTime

  business Business @relation(fields: [businessId], references: [id])

  @@index([businessId], map: "idx_seller_score_biz")
  @@index([compositeScore], map: "idx_seller_score_composite")
}
```

Add to `Business` model:

```prisma
sellerScore SellerScore?
```

Add to `OrderTracking` model:

```prisma
dispatchProofUrl  String?
dispatchProofAt   DateTime?
```

## §4 TRANSACTION BOUNDARY GOVERNANCE

Inherited from Sprint 4. Additions for Sprint 5:

### §4.0 STATUS_TIMESTAMP_FIELD_MAP — Required Constant (INV-S5-38)

This constant MUST be defined as an explicit map in `seller-order.service.ts`. Never compute the field name from enum values at runtime.

```typescript
// MANDATORY: Define this constant at module level (INV-S5-38)
const STATUS_TIMESTAMP_FIELD_MAP: Partial<Record<OrderStatus, string>> = {
  CONFIRMED: "confirmedAt",
  PROCESSING: "processingAt",
  SHIPPED: "shippedAt",
} as const;
// FORBIDDEN: computing field name dynamically — e.g. `${status.toLowerCase()}At`
// FORBIDDEN: using any status not in this map — they are system-controlled (DELIVERED, COMPLETED, etc.)
```

### §4.1 Seller Status Transition Transaction Pattern

```typescript
// ✅ CORRECT — all three writes inside single $transaction (INV-S5-8)
async transitionStatus(orderId: string, sellerId: string, dto: TransitionStatusDto, tx?: PrismaClient) {

  // STEP 1 (OUTSIDE $transaction): trackingNumber validation (INV-S5-5)
  if (dto.toStatus === 'SHIPPED' && !dto.trackingNumber?.trim()) {
    throw new UnprocessableEntityException({ code: 'TRACKING_NUMBER_REQUIRED' });
  }

  // STEP 2 (OUTSIDE $transaction): State machine validation (INV-S5-32)
  const order = await this.sellerOrderRepo.findByIdForSeller(orderId, sellerId);
  validateSellerTransition(order.status, dto.toStatus); // throws 422 on invalid

  // STEP 3 (OUTSIDE $transaction): Idempotency check (INV-6)
  const idemKey = `status-transition:${orderId}:${dto.toStatus}:${dto.idempotencyKey}`;
  const alreadyDone = await this.redis.set(idemKey, '1', 'EX', 86400, 'NX');
  if (alreadyDone === null) return this.sellerOrderRepo.findByIdForSeller(orderId, sellerId);

  // STEP 4 ($transaction — all three writes atomic) (INV-S5-39: timeout required)
  return await this.prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
    const updated = await tx.order.update({
      where: { id: orderId },
      data: {
        status: dto.toStatus,
        [`${STATUS_TIMESTAMP_FIELD_MAP[dto.toStatus]}`]: new Date(),
      },
    });
    await tx.orderStatusHistory.create({  // INV-13: APPEND-ONLY
      data: {
        orderId,
        statusFrom: order.status,
        statusTo: dto.toStatus,
        actorId: sellerId,             // Business.id — NOT User.id (INV-S5-1)
        actorRole: SystemActorType.SELLER,
        reason: dto.reason,
        historyMonth: formatYearMonth(new Date()),
        timestamp: new Date(),
      },
    });
    await tx.eventOutbox.create({       // INV-S5-8: inside transaction
      data: {
        eventType: 'OrderStatusChanged',
        eventVersion: '1.0',            // INV-20
        schemaVersion: '5.0',           // INV-S5-23
        payload: buildOrderStatusChangedPayload(updated, order.status, sellerId, dto),
        deduplicationKey: `order-status-changed-${orderId}-${dto.toStatus}`,
        eventMonth: formatYearMonth(new Date()),
        status: 'PENDING',
      },
    });
    return updated;
  });
  // STEP 5 (OUTSIDE $transaction): Redis KPI cache invalidation (INV-S5-29)
}
```

### §4.2 What MUST NOT Be Inside `$transaction` (Sprint 5)

```
❌ redis.get() / redis.set()              ← Redis I/O (Sprint 3 §3.3)
❌ S3 presigned URL generation            ← External HTTP
❌ S3 HEAD request (dispatch proof verify) ← External HTTP
❌ BullMQ queue.add()                     ← Queue I/O
❌ InventoryService.getAvailability()     ← May have its own transaction
❌ Scorecard computation queries          ← READ queries, not part of write tx
❌ KPI cache population                   ← Redis I/O
```

## §5 REDIS KEY REGISTRY

All existing Sprint 1–4 keys are inherited. Sprint 5 additions:

| Key Pattern                                        | Purpose                                          | TTL                               | Authority                 |
| -------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------ | --------------------------------- | ------------------------- |
| `seller_biz:{userId}`                              | `SellerContextGuard` businessId resolution cache | 60s                               | Redis (display) → DB      |
| `kpi:{businessId}:{segment}:{YYYY-MM-DD}`          | Seller KPI dashboard cache                       | **60+jitter(0..15)s** (INV-S5-36) | Redis (display) → DB      |
| `status-transition:{orderId}:{toStatus}:{idemKey}` | Status transition idempotency (INV-6)            | 86400s (24h)                      | Redis SET NX              |
| `reorder_rate:{userId}`                            | Reorder rate limit (5/hour)                      | 3600s                             | Redis Lua script (INV-21) |
| `seller_score:{businessId}`                        | Optional scorecard read cache                    | 360s (6min)                       | Redis (display) → DB      |

**Cache governance rules (inherited from Sprint 4):**

- Every cache GET wrapped in try/catch — miss or error → fall through to DB (INV-S5-15, INV-8)
- Cache SET after DB write — never before
- Cache DEL after `$transaction` commits — never inside
- Redis eviction/outage → graceful DB fallback always
- **KPI TTL MUST use jitter** — `60 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 15)` — never flat 60 (INV-S5-36)

## §6 BULLMQ QUEUE ARCHITECTURE

### §6.1 Existing Queues (Sprint 4 — do not modify)

| Queue      | Workers                                                                                    | Cron |
| ---------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | ---- |
| `payments` | `PaymentWebhookProcessorWorker`, `PaymentReconciliationWorker`, `PaymentRetryExpiryWorker` | yes  |
| `carts`    | `CartCleanupWorker`                                                                        | yes  |

### §6.2 New Queue: `scoring`

**Justification:** Clean separation from `payments` queue. Scorecard failures should not DLQ alongside payment failures.

```typescript
// In SellerScorecardModule.onModuleInit()
const scoringQueue = this.bullMQService.getQueue("scoring");

// Cron job — stable jobId prevents duplicates on restart (INV-S5-19)
await scoringQueue.add(
  "seller-scorecard-cron",
  {},
  {
    jobId: "seller-scorecard-cron", // ← STABLE — prevents duplicate on API restart
    repeat: { pattern: "0 */6 * * *" }, // every 6 hours
    removeOnComplete: 100,
    removeOnFail: 200,
  },
);
```

**`SellerScorecardWorker`:**

- Processes `seller-scorecard-cron` jobs
- Queries all active businesses: `WHERE isDeleted = false AND kycStatus = 'VERIFIED'`
- For each business: computes 3-metric scorecard
- Upserts `SellerScore` record
- Emits `SupplierScoreUpdated` to `EventOutbox` if score changed ≥1 point (INV-S5-18)
- Emits `seller_scorecard_run_total` counter, `seller_scorecard_latency_ms` histogram
- DLQ after 3 failures → `seller_scorecard_dlq_size` gauge

## §9 SECURITY ARCHITECTURE

### §9.1 SellerContextGuard — Complete Implementation

```typescript
@Injectable()
export class SellerContextGuard implements CanActivate {
  constructor(
    private readonly prisma: PrismaService,
    private readonly redis: RedisService,
    private readonly metrics: MetricsService,
  ) {}

  async canActivate(context: ExecutionContext): Promise<boolean> {
    const req = context.switchToHttp().getRequest();
    const userId = req.user.id; // from JwtAuthGuard — already verified

    const cacheKey = `seller_biz:${userId}`;
    let business: Business | null = null;

    // Cache read — with bypass on failure (INV-S5-15 philosophy applied to guard)
    try {
      const cached = await this.redis.get(cacheKey);
      if (cached) {
        business = JSON.parse(cached);
      }
    } catch {
      // Redis down — proceed to DB
    }

    if (!business) {
      business = await this.prisma.business.findFirst({
        where: { ownerId: userId, isDeleted: false },
        select: { id: true, segment: true, kycStatus: true, name: true },
      });

      if (business) {
        try {
          await this.redis.set(cacheKey, JSON.stringify(business), "EX", 60);
        } catch {
          /* silent */
        }
      }
    }

    if (!business) {
      throw new ForbiddenException({ code: "BUSINESS_NOT_FOUND" });
    }
    if (business.kycStatus === KycStatus.SUSPENDED) {
      throw new ForbiddenException({ code: "BUSINESS_SUSPENDED" });
    }

    // Attach to request — used by all seller controllers and repositories
    req.seller = {
      businessId: business.id,
      segment: business.segment,
      businessName: business.name,
    };

    return true;
  }
}
```

### §9.4 Dispatch Proof Upload Security

```typescript
// S3Service.generateDispatchProofUploadUrl() — key scoping (INV-S5-26)
async generateDispatchProofUploadUrl(
  businessId: string,   // from req.seller.businessId (guard-verified)
  orderId: string,
): Promise<{ uploadUrl: string; s3Key: string; expiresAt: string }> {

  const timestamp = Date.now();
  const s3Key = `dispatch-proofs/${businessId}/${orderId}/${timestamp}_proof`;
  // Key prefix is server-controlled — client cannot choose arbitrary prefix

  const uploadUrl = await this.s3.createPresignedPost({
    Bucket: process.env.S3_BUCKET,
    Key: s3Key,
    Conditions: [
      ['content-length-range', 1, 5 * 1024 * 1024],  // 1B to 5MB
      // AUDIT-S5-1: S3 policy conditions must cover ALL allowed MIME types.
      // Using ['starts-with', 'image/'] alone would allow image/gif, image/tiff etc.
      // and would EXCLUDE application/pdf, creating a bypass gap.
      // CORRECT: enumerate each allowed prefix explicitly:
      ['starts-with', '$Content-Type', 'image/jpeg'],
      ['starts-with', '$Content-Type', 'image/png'],
      ['starts-with', '$Content-Type', 'image/webp'],
      ['starts-with', '$Content-Type', 'application/pdf'],
    ],
    // NOTE: S3 policy is a FIRST defense. Server-side MIME check in confirmDispatchProof()
    // is the AUTHORITATIVE gate (INV-S5-35). Both must be present.
    Expires: 300, // 5 minutes
  });

  return { uploadUrl, s3Key, expiresAt: new Date(Date.now() + 300000).toISOString() };
}

// Confirm step — cross-seller prefix check (INV-S5-11)
async confirmDispatchProof(
  businessId: string,
  orderId: string,
  s3Key: string,
): Promise<void> {
  // Ownership check — s3Key must start with seller's prefix
  if (!s3Key.startsWith(`dispatch-proofs/${businessId}/`)) {
    throw new ForbiddenException({ code: 'S3_KEY_OWNERSHIP_VIOLATION' });
  }

  // S3 HEAD verify — file must exist (INV-S5-10)
  const headResult = await this.s3.headObject({ Bucket: process.env.S3_BUCKET, Key: s3Key });
  if (!headResult) {
    throw new UnprocessableEntityException({ code: 'FILE_NOT_FOUND_IN_S3' });
  }

  // MANDATORY MIME validation from S3 HEAD Content-Type (INV-S5-35)
  // S3 signed URL conditions restrict upload MIME at generation time, but S3 does not block
  // all bypasses — server-side check is the authoritative gate.
  const ALLOWED_MIME_TYPES = ['image/jpeg', 'image/png', 'image/webp', 'application/pdf'];
  const contentType = headResult.ContentType ?? '';
  if (!ALLOWED_MIME_TYPES.includes(contentType)) {
    throw new UnprocessableEntityException({
      code: 'INVALID_FILE_TYPE',
      allowedTypes: ALLOWED_MIME_TYPES,
      receivedType: contentType,
    });
  }

  // Write to DB AFTER verification (INV-S5-10)
  // Use upsert for idempotency — re-confirmation with same s3Key is a no-op
  await this.prisma.orderTracking.upsert({
    where: { orderId },
    create: {
      orderId,
      status: 'DISPATCHED',
      dispatchProofUrl: `https://${process.env.S3_BUCKET}.s3.amazonaws.com/${s3Key}`,
      dispatchProofAt: new Date(),
    },
    update: {
      dispatchProofUrl: `https://${process.env.S3_BUCKET}.s3.amazonaws.com/${s3Key}`,
      dispatchProofAt: new Date(),
    },
  });
  // NOTE: NO EventOutbox event here (INV-S5-9)
  // NOTE: NO OrderStatusHistory here (INV-S5-9) — proof upload is not a status transition
}
```

## §10 EVENTOUTBOX GOVERNANCE

### §10.1 Sprint 5 Event Catalog

**Event 1: `OrderStatusChanged`**

```typescript
{
  eventType: 'OrderStatusChanged',
  eventVersion: '1.0',
  schemaVersion: '5.0',
  deduplicationKey: `order-status-changed-${orderId}-${toStatus}`,
  // Dedup rationale: order can only reach each status ONCE (state machine enforced)
  // If transition is retried with same idempotency key → Redis SET NX prevents duplicate DB write
  payload: {
    orderId: string,
    orderNumber: string,
    buyerId: string,          // User.id — Sprint 6 uses to lookup phone
    sellerId: string,         // Business.id
    segment: string,
    statusFrom: string,
    statusTo: string,
    actorId: string,          // Business.id for SELLER, User.id for BUYER, 'SYSTEM' for system
    actorRole: 'SELLER' | 'SYSTEM' | 'BUYER',
    timestamp: string,        // ISO8601
    trackingNumber?: string,  // populated ONLY when statusTo = 'SHIPPED'
    estimatedDelivery?: string,
  },
  eventMonth: formatYearMonth(new Date()),
  status: 'PENDING',
}
```

**Event 2: `SupplierScoreUpdated`**

```typescript
{
  eventType: 'SupplierScoreUpdated',
  eventVersion: '1.0',
  schemaVersion: '5.0',
  deduplicationKey: `supplier-score-updated-${businessId}-${new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 13)}`,
  // Dedup rationale: one scorecard run per business per cron-hour
  // ISO slice to hour: "2026-05-29T14" — deterministic, no Date.now() (INV-17, INV-S5-17)
  payload: {
    businessId: string,
    compositeScore: number,         // 0-100
    dispatchSpeedScore: number,
    deliveryQualityScore: number,
    acceptanceRate: number,
    previousCompositeScore: number | null,
    calculatedAt: string,
    orderCount: number,
  },
  eventMonth: formatYearMonth(new Date()),
  status: 'PENDING',
}
```

### §10.2 EventOutbox Rules for Sprint 5

```
RULE 1: All EventOutbox.create() calls happen INSIDE the same $transaction that modifies order state (INV-S5-8)
RULE 2: SupplierScoreUpdated emitted OUTSIDE $transaction — scorecard cron is a read operation (INV-S5-18)
RULE 3: Dispatch proof upload does NOT emit any EventOutbox event (INV-S5-9)
RULE 4: schemaVersion is '5.0' on ALL Sprint 5 EventOutbox records (INV-S5-23)
RULE 5: eventVersion is '1.0' (INV-20)
RULE 6: deduplicationKey is deterministic — no Date.now(), no randomUUID() (INV-17)
```

### §11.2 New Alerts

| Alert                       | Condition                                                          | Severity | Action                        |
| --------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------ | -------- | ----------------------------- |
| Order stuck in PROCESSING   | `status=PROCESSING AND processingAt < now() - 48h`                 | WARNING  | Ops reviews                   |
| Seller dispatch latency     | `seller_dispatch_time_hours p95 > 72h`                             | WARNING  | Notify ops                    |
| Dispatch proof failure rate | `dispatch_proof_upload_total{outcome!="success"} > 20% in 5m`      | ERROR    | Investigate S3                |
| S3 key ownership violations | `dispatch_proof_upload_total{outcome="key_violation"} > 5 in 5m`   | CRITICAL | Possible seller impersonation |
| KPI Redis bypass continuous | `kpi_redis_bypass_total > 0 for 5m`                                | WARNING  | Redis degraded                |
| Scorecard cron missed       | `seller_scorecard_run_total` not incremented in 7h                 | ERROR    | Check BullMQ                  |
| Scorecard DLQ growing       | `seller_scorecard_dlq_size > 0`                                    | ERROR    | Investigate worker failures   |
| Reorder rate limit bypass   | `buyer_reorder_total{outcome="success"} > 20 from same buyerId/1h` | WARNING  | Redis rate limit may be down  |

## §12 DEGRADED-MODE BEHAVIOR

| Component                          | Redis Down                                          | S3 Down                               | DB Slow              |
| ---------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------- | -------------------- |
| `GET /seller/dashboard/kpis`       | Bypass cache → DB query (INV-S5-15)                 | N/A                                   | 503 after 5s timeout |
| `SellerContextGuard`               | Bypass cache → DB query                             | N/A                                   | 503                  |
| `PATCH /seller/orders/:id/status`  | Idempotency check fails → 503                       | N/A                                   | 503                  |
| `POST /dispatch-proof/upload-url`  | N/A (URL generation is S3 SDK call)                 | 503                                   | N/A                  |
| `POST /dispatch-proof/confirm`     | N/A                                                 | HEAD fails → 422 FILE_NOT_FOUND_IN_S3 | 503                  |
| `POST /buyer/orders/:id/reorder`   | Rate limit bypassed (conservative: allow 1 reorder) | N/A                                   | 503                  |
| `GET /buyer/orders/:id` (timeline) | Serve from DB directly                              | N/A                                   | 503                  |
| `SellerScorecardWorker`            | Score written to DB, EventOutbox emit attempted     | N/A                                   | Retry in BullMQ      |

**Redis degradation rule:** Dashboard availability > cache availability. ALWAYS. Fail to serve from Redis means fall through to DB, not fail request.

```typescript
// BuyerOrderRepository — ownership filter mandatory on ALL methods (INV-18)
class BuyerOrderRepository {
  // Cursor-paginated list (INV-S5-20)
  async findManyForBuyer(
    buyerId: string,
    filter: {
      status?: OrderStatus;
      cursor?: string; // orderId
      limit: number;
    },
  ): Promise<{ orders: Order[]; nextCursor: string | null; hasMore: boolean }> {
    const orders = await this.prisma.order.findMany({
      where: {
        buyerId, // MANDATORY ownership filter (INV-18)
        isDeleted: false,
        ...(filter.status && { status: filter.status }),
        ...(filter.cursor && { id: { lt: filter.cursor } }), // cursor = orderId
      },
      include: {
        items: { take: 3 }, // preview only — no N+1 (INV-S5-31)
        payments: { select: { status: true, method: true }, take: 1 },
      },
      orderBy: { createdAt: "desc" },
      take: filter.limit + 1, // fetch +1 to determine hasMore
    });

    const hasMore = orders.length > filter.limit;
    if (hasMore) orders.pop();
    return {
      orders,
      nextCursor: hasMore ? (orders[orders.length - 1]?.id ?? null) : null,
      hasMore,
    };
  }

  // Full detail with timeline (INV-S5-31)
  async findByIdForBuyer(
    orderId: string,
    buyerId: string,
  ): Promise<Order & { timeline }> {
    const order = await this.prisma.order.findFirst({
      where: { id: orderId, buyerId, isDeleted: false }, // buyerId filter mandatory (INV-18)
      include: {
        items: true, // full items on detail
        tracking: {
          orderBy: { createdAt: "desc" },
          take: 1,
        },
      },
    });
    if (!order) throw new NotFoundException({ code: "ORDER_NOT_FOUND" });

    // Fetch status history separately — avoids massive include on every detail view
    const statusHistory = await this.prisma.orderStatusHistory.findMany({
      where: { orderId },
      orderBy: { timestamp: "asc" },
    });

    return { ...order, statusHistory };
  }

  async cancelOrder(orderId: string, buyerId: string): Promise<void> {
    // Cancellation logic with 2-hour grace window (INV-S5-24)
  }
}
```

**Buyer Cancellation Grace Window (INV-S5-24):**

```typescript
async cancelOrder(orderId: string, buyerId: string, reason: string): Promise<Order> {
  const order = await this.buyerOrderRepo.findByIdForBuyer(orderId, buyerId);

  if (order.status === 'CANCELLED' || order.status === 'COMPLETED') {
    throw new UnprocessableEntityException({ code: 'ORDER_ALREADY_TERMINAL' });
  }

  if (order.status === 'CONFIRMED') {
    // 2-hour grace window after confirmation (INV-S5-24)
    const gracePeriodMs = 2 * 60 * 60 * 1000; // 2 hours
    const confirmedAt = order.confirmedAt!.getTime();
    if (Date.now() > confirmedAt + gracePeriodMs) {
      throw new UnprocessableEntityException({ code: 'CANCELLATION_WINDOW_EXPIRED' });
    }
  }

  if (order.status === 'SHIPPED' || order.status === 'PROCESSING') {
    throw new UnprocessableEntityException({ code: 'ORDER_TOO_FAR_IN_FULFILLMENT' });
  }

  // Valid — proceed with cancellation inside $transaction (INV-S5-39: timeout required)
  const updated = await this.prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
    const u = await tx.order.update({
      where: { id: orderId },
      data: { status: 'CANCELLED', cancelledAt: new Date() },
    });
    await tx.orderStatusHistory.create({  // INV-13: APPEND-ONLY
      data: {
        orderId,
        statusFrom: order.status,
        statusTo: 'CANCELLED',
        actorId: buyerId,
        actorRole: SystemActorType.BUYER,  // INV-S5-22
        reason,
        historyMonth: formatYearMonth(new Date()),
        timestamp: new Date(),
      },
    });
    await tx.eventOutbox.create({          // INV-S5-8: inside $transaction
      data: {
        eventType: 'OrderStatusChanged',
        eventVersion: '1.0',               // INV-20
        schemaVersion: '5.0',              // INV-S5-23
        deduplicationKey: `order-status-changed-${orderId}-CANCELLED`,  // INV-17
        payload: {
          orderId, orderNumber: order.orderNumber,
          buyerId, sellerId: order.sellerId, segment: order.segment,
          statusFrom: order.status, statusTo: 'CANCELLED',
          actorId: buyerId, actorRole: 'BUYER',
          timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
        },
        eventMonth: formatYearMonth(new Date()),
        status: 'PENDING',
      },
    });
    return u;
  }, { timeout: 5000 });  // INV-S5-39

  // MANDATORY POST-TX: Release inventory reservation (INV-S5-34)
  // This MUST happen AFTER $transaction commits — NEVER inside (Sprint 3 INV-3)
  // Only release if order was PLACED/CONFIRMED (has an active reservation)
  if (order.status === 'PLACED' || order.status === 'CONFIRMED') {
    try {
      // AUDIT-S5-2: Sprint 3 contract — releaseAllForOrder(orderId, reason, actorId)
      // CORRECT: 3 parameters — orderId, ReleaseReason enum value, actorId
      // WRONG (compile error): releaseAllForOrder(orderId, buyerId) — missing reason
      // InventoryService.releaseAllForOrder() is idempotent (INV-S5-41)
      await this.inventoryService.releaseAllForOrder(orderId, 'ORDER_CANCELLED', buyerId);
    } catch (releaseErr) {
      // Log CRITICAL — inventory stuck reserved. Ops must investigate.
      this.logger.error({ orderId, buyerId, error: releaseErr.message }, 'INVENTORY_RELEASE_FAILED_AFTER_CANCEL');
      // Do NOT re-throw — order is already CANCELLED. Release failure is ops concern.
    }
  }

  return updated;
}
```

**Payment Retry Status Endpoint:**

```typescript
// PaymentService.getRetryStatus()
async getRetryStatus(orderId: string, buyerId: string): Promise<RetryStatusDto> {
  const order = await this.orderRepo.findByIdForBuyer(orderId, buyerId);

  if (order.status !== 'PAYMENT_FAILED') {
    return { retryAllowed: false, retryWindowRemainingMs: null, attemptCount: 0 };
  }

  // Dual authority check (INV-23)
  const retryWindowMs = 30 * 60 * 1000; // 30 minutes
  const paymentFailedAt = order.paymentFailedAt?.getTime() ?? 0;
  const elapsed = Date.now() - paymentFailedAt;
  const remaining = retryWindowMs - elapsed;

  const failedPayments = await this.paymentRepo.findFailedByOrderId(orderId);

  return {
    retryAllowed: remaining > 0 && failedPayments.length < 3,
    retryWindowRemainingMs: remaining > 0 ? remaining : null,
    attemptCount: failedPayments.length,
  };
}
```

```typescript
@Injectable()
export class SellerKpiService {
  async getKpis(businessId: string, segment: Segment): Promise<SellerKpiDto> {
    const today = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
    const cacheKey = `kpi:${businessId}:${segment}:${today}`;

    // Cache read with bypass on failure (INV-S5-15)
    let redisError = false;
    try {
      const raw = await this.redis.get(cacheKey);
      if (raw) {
        // Cache HIT — served from Redis, no bypass
        return { ...(JSON.parse(raw) as SellerKpiDto), isCacheBypass: false };
      }
    } catch (redisErr) {
      redisError = true;
      this.logger.warn(
        { businessId, error: redisErr.message, segment },
        "KPI_REDIS_BYPASS",
      );
      this.metrics.kpiRedisBypassTotal.inc({ segment }); // observability (INV-S5-15)
    }

    // Cache MISS or Redis error — DB fallback (INV-S5-14: all queries scoped to businessId)
    const kpis = await this.sellerKpiRepo.computeKpis(businessId, segment);

    // Populate cache with JITTER TTL to prevent thundering herd (INV-S5-36)
    // FORBIDDEN: flat 'EX', 60 — causes stampede when many sellers expire simultaneously
    // REQUIRED: 60 + random(0..15) — staggers expiry across seller population
    if (!redisError) {
      const jitteredTtl = 60 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 15); // 60–75 seconds
      try {
        await this.redis.set(cacheKey, JSON.stringify(kpis), "EX", jitteredTtl);
      } catch {
        /* silent — Redis still down, DB result returned */
      }
    }

    // isCacheBypass = true whenever served from DB (Redis miss OR Redis error)
    return { ...kpis, isCacheBypass: true };
  }
}

// SellerKpiRepository — all queries MANDATORY scoped to businessId (INV-S5-14, INV-S5-33)
class SellerKpiRepository {
  async computeKpis(
    businessId: string,
    segment: Segment,
  ): Promise<SellerKpiRaw> {
    const today = new Date();
    today.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);

    // 4 independent queries — each hits its own index cleanly
    const [ordersToday, revenueToday, pendingCount, lowStockCount] =
      await Promise.all([
        this.prisma.order.count({
          where: {
            sellerId: businessId, // MANDATORY (INV-S5-14)
            segment, // MANDATORY (INV-S5-33)
            createdAt: { gte: today },
            isDeleted: false,
          },
        }),
        this.prisma.order.aggregate({
          where: {
            sellerId: businessId, // MANDATORY (INV-S5-14)
            segment,
            createdAt: { gte: today },
            status: { notIn: ["CANCELLED", "PAYMENT_FAILED"] },
            isDeleted: false,
          },
          _sum: { grandTotal: true },
        }),
        this.prisma.order.count({
          where: {
            sellerId: businessId, // MANDATORY (INV-S5-14)
            segment,
            status: { in: ["PLACED", "CONFIRMED", "PROCESSING"] },
            isDeleted: false,
          },
        }),
        this.prisma.inventory.count({
          where: {
            businessId, // MANDATORY (INV-S5-14)
            segment,
            isLowStock: true,
          },
        }),
      ]);

    return {
      ordersToday,
      revenueToday: (revenueToday._sum.grandTotal ?? new Decimal(0)).toString(),
      pendingOrderCount: pendingCount,
      lowStockProductCount: lowStockCount,
    };
  }
}
```

**Status Transition Validation (INV-S5-5, INV-S5-6, INV-S5-7, INV-S5-32):**

```typescript
// order-state-machine.ts — EXTEND with seller-specific transition map
const SELLER_VALID_TRANSITIONS: Record<string, OrderStatus[]> = {
  PLACED: ['CONFIRMED'],
  CONFIRMED: ['PROCESSING', 'SHIPPED'],
  PROCESSING: ['SHIPPED'],
  // All other statuses: seller cannot initiate transitions
};

export function validateSellerTransition(current: OrderStatus, next: OrderStatus): void {
  // DELIVERED guard — Sprint 7 only (INV-S5-7)
  if (next === 'DELIVERED' || next === 'COMPLETED') {
    throw new UnprocessableEntityException({
      code: 'TRANSITION_RESERVED_FOR_ADMIN',
      message: `Transition to ${next} is reserved for Sprint 7 Admin`,
    });
  }

  const allowed = SELLER_VALID_TRANSITIONS[current] ?? [];
  if (!allowed.includes(next)) {
    throw new UnprocessableEntityException({
      code: 'INVALID_STATUS_TRANSITION',
      from: current,
      to: next,
      allowedTransitions: allowed,
    });
  }
}

// SellerOrderService.transitionStatus() — complete implementation (INV-S5-8)
async transitionStatus(
  orderId: string,
  seller: SellerContext,        // from req.seller (SellerContextGuard)
  dto: TransitionStatusDto,
): Promise<SellerOrderView> {

  // STEP 1: trackingNumber validation BEFORE everything (INV-S5-5)
  if (dto.toStatus === 'SHIPPED') {
    if (!dto.trackingNumber?.trim()) {
      throw new UnprocessableEntityException({ code: 'TRACKING_NUMBER_REQUIRED' });
    }
  }

  // STEP 2: State machine validation BEFORE $transaction (INV-S5-32)
  const order = await this.sellerOrderRepo.findByIdForSeller(orderId, seller.businessId);
  validateSellerTransition(order.status, dto.toStatus);  // throws 422 on invalid

  // STEP 3: Idempotency check BEFORE $transaction (INV-6)
  const idemKey = `status-transition:${orderId}:${dto.toStatus}:${dto.idempotencyKey}`;
  const isNew = await this.redis.set(idemKey, '1', 'EX', 86400, 'NX');
  if (isNew === null) {
    // Already processed — return current state
    return this.sellerOrderRepo.findByIdForSeller(orderId, seller.businessId);
  }

  // STEP 4: Atomic transition inside $transaction (INV-S5-8)
  // AUDIT-S5-3: Use STATUS_TIMESTAMP_FIELD_MAP (defined in §4.0) — NOT STATUS_TIMESTAMP_MAP
  // STATUS_TIMESTAMP_MAP is undefined → compile error. Only STATUS_TIMESTAMP_FIELD_MAP exists.
  const timestampField = STATUS_TIMESTAMP_FIELD_MAP[dto.toStatus];
  await this.prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
    await tx.order.update({
      where: { id: orderId },
      data: {
        status: dto.toStatus,
        [timestampField]: new Date(),
      },
    });
    await tx.orderStatusHistory.create({  // INV-13: APPEND-ONLY
      data: {
        orderId,
        statusFrom: order.status,
        statusTo: dto.toStatus,
        actorId: seller.businessId,       // Business.id (INV-S5-1)
        actorRole: SystemActorType.SELLER, // INV-S5-22
        reason: dto.reason,
        historyMonth: formatYearMonth(new Date()),
      },
    });
    await tx.eventOutbox.create({         // INV-S5-8: inside $transaction
      data: {
        eventType: 'OrderStatusChanged',
        eventVersion: '1.0',              // INV-20
        schemaVersion: '5.0',             // INV-S5-23
        deduplicationKey: `order-status-changed-${orderId}-${dto.toStatus}`,  // INV-17
        payload: {
          orderId,
          orderNumber: order.orderNumber,
          buyerId: order.buyerId,
          sellerId: seller.businessId,
          segment: seller.segment,
          statusFrom: order.status,
          statusTo: dto.toStatus,
          actorId: seller.businessId,
          actorRole: 'SELLER',
          timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
          ...(dto.toStatus === 'SHIPPED' && { trackingNumber: dto.trackingNumber }),
        },
        eventMonth: formatYearMonth(new Date()),
        status: 'PENDING',
      },
    });
  }, { timeout: 5000 });  // INV-S5-39: mandatory timeout prevents lock-duration amplification

  // STEP 5: Metrics + cache invalidation AFTER $transaction (INV-S5-29)
  this.metrics.orderStatusTransitionTotal.inc({
    from: order.status,
    to: dto.toStatus,
    actor: 'SELLER',
  });
  if (dto.toStatus === 'SHIPPED' && order.confirmedAt) {
    const dispatchHours = (Date.now() - order.confirmedAt.getTime()) / 3600000;
    this.metrics.sellerDispatchTimeHours.observe({ segment: seller.segment }, dispatchHours);
  }
  await this.redis.del(`kpi:${seller.businessId}:${seller.segment}:${new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10)}`).catch(() => {});

  return this.sellerOrderRepo.findByIdForSeller(orderId, seller.businessId);
}
```

**Acceptance Criteria:**

```
✅ GET /seller/orders → returns only this seller's orders (Seller B cannot see Seller A's orders)
✅ GET /seller/orders/:id → returns filtered OrderItems (only seller's products)
✅ GET /seller/orders/:id → response contains buyerCode, NOT raw buyerId, buyer phone, or buyer email
✅ PATCH /seller/orders/:id/status (PLACED → CONFIRMED) → 200, order CONFIRMED
✅ PATCH /seller/orders/:id/status (CONFIRMED → SHIPPED, no trackingNumber) → 422 TRACKING_NUMBER_REQUIRED
✅ PATCH /seller/orders/:id/status (CONFIRMED → SHIPPED, trackingNumber provided) → 200, order SHIPPED
✅ PATCH /seller/orders/:id/status (PLACED → SHIPPED — invalid) → 422 INVALID_STATUS_TRANSITION
✅ PATCH /seller/orders/:id/status (SHIPPED → DELIVERED — Sprint 7) → 422 TRANSITION_RESERVED_FOR_ADMIN
✅ PATCH /seller/orders/:id/status (same Idempotency-Key twice) → same 200, no duplicate OrderStatusHistory
✅ OrderStatusHistory: actorRole = SELLER, actorId = businessId (NOT userId)
✅ EventOutbox: OrderStatusChanged event with correct payload and schemaVersion: '5.0'
✅ order_status_transition_total counter incremented
✅ BUYER cannot call PATCH /seller/orders/:id/status → 403
✅ Seller A cannot transition Seller B's order → 404 ORDER_NOT_FOUND
✅ pnpm build → zero errors
```

```
   FIX: actorId in OrderStatusHistory is always seller.businessId from SellerContextGuard

❌ TRAP: Forgetting to add EventOutbox.create() inside $transaction (INV-S5-8)
   FIX: ALL THREE writes (order.update, orderStatusHistory.create, eventOutbox.create) inside single $transaction

❌ TRAP: Returning raw order.buyerId in SellerOrderView (INV-S5-4)
   FIX: mapToSellerView() always applies maskBuyerId() and removes buyerId field

❌ TRAP: Allowing SHIPPED without checking trackingNumber.trim().length > 0 (INV-S5-5)

❌ TRAP: include: { items: true } without { where: { sellerId } } → returns ALL order items including other sellers'
```

## §18 PHASE 5 — DISPATCH WORKFLOW

**Objective:** Seller can upload dispatch proof (optional) after marking SHIPPED. S3 pre-signed URL pattern. HEAD verification before DB write.

**Model Recommended:** Claude Sonnet (S3 scoping security is critical — upload abuse prevention)

**Files Created:**

- `apps/api/src/modules/seller/controllers/seller-orders.controller.ts` — dispatch proof endpoints
- `apps/api/src/modules/s3/s3.service.ts` — pre-signed URL generation and HEAD verification

**Complete Dispatch Proof Workflow:**

```
Order MUST be in SHIPPED/OUT_FOR_DELIVERY/DELIVERED status for proof upload
(Cannot upload proof for PLACED or CONFIRMED orders — seller hasn't shipped yet)

Step 1: POST /seller/orders/:id/dispatch-proof/upload-url
  → Validate order is in allowed status (SHIPPED+)
  → SellerContextGuard provides seller.businessId
  → S3Service.generateDispatchProofUploadUrl(businessId, orderId)
    → s3Key = dispatch-proofs/{businessId}/{orderId}/{timestamp}_proof
    → Pre-signed PUT URL with 5MB content-length-range constraint
    → Expires in 5 minutes
  → Return { uploadUrl, s3Key, expiresAt }

Step 2: Client uploads directly to S3
  → PUT {uploadUrl} with file bytes
  → Content-Type must be image/* or application/pdf
  → Content-Length must be ≤ 5MB
  → S3 enforces this via signed URL policy

Step 3: POST /seller/orders/:id/dispatch-proof/confirm
  → Body: { s3Key }
  → Validate s3Key starts with dispatch-proofs/{seller.businessId}/ (INV-S5-11)
  → S3Service.headObject({ Key: s3Key }) — file must exist (INV-S5-10)
  → If HEAD fails → 422 FILE_NOT_FOUND_IN_S3
  → Validate headResult.ContentType against ALLOWED_MIME_TYPES (INV-S5-35)
  → Allowed: image/jpeg, image/png, image/webp, application/pdf
  → Rejected MIME → 422 INVALID_FILE_TYPE
  → prisma.orderTracking.upsert({ orderId, status: 'DISPATCHED', dispatchProofUrl, dispatchProofAt })
  → NO EventOutbox event (INV-S5-9)
  → NO OrderStatusHistory (INV-S5-9)
  → dispatch_proof_upload_total.inc({ outcome: 'success' })
  → Return { dispatchProofUrl }
```

**Acceptance Criteria:**

```
✅ POST .../upload-url (SHIPPED order) → 200, returns uploadUrl + s3Key
✅ POST .../upload-url (PLACED order) → 422 ORDER_NOT_SHIPPED_YET
✅ S3 direct upload with returned uploadUrl → 200 from S3
✅ S3 upload with content > 5MB → 400 from S3 (size enforcement)
✅ POST .../confirm (valid s3Key, JPEG file uploaded) → 200, dispatchProofUrl stored in OrderTracking
✅ POST .../confirm (valid s3Key, PDF file uploaded) → 200, dispatchProofUrl stored in OrderTracking
✅ POST .../confirm (valid s3Key, .exe file uploaded) → 422 INVALID_FILE_TYPE (MIME check, INV-S5-35)
✅ POST .../confirm (s3Key not uploaded yet) → 422 FILE_NOT_FOUND_IN_S3
✅ POST .../confirm (s3Key with wrong businessId prefix) → 403 S3_KEY_OWNERSHIP_VIOLATION
✅ POST .../confirm → NO new OrderStatusHistory row created (INV-S5-9)
✅ POST .../confirm → NO new EventOutbox event created (INV-S5-9)
✅ POST .../confirm twice with same s3Key → idempotent 200 (upsert, no duplicate OrderTracking row)
✅ Seller A cannot upload proof for Seller B's order (SellerContextGuard + ownership check)
✅ dispatch_proof_upload_total counter incremented on success and each failure type
✅ GET /buyer/orders/:id → timeline tracking shows dispatchProofUrl (signed URL for buyer view)
✅ pnpm build → zero errors
```

**AI Footguns:**

```
❌ TRAP: Creating EventOutbox event on dispatch proof confirm (INV-S5-9)
   FIX: Dispatch proof upload is NOT a status transition. No EventOutbox. No OrderStatusHistory.

❌ TRAP: Allowing upload for any order status (PLACED, CONFIRMED orders) → proof before shipment
   FIX: Validate order.status in ['SHIPPED', 'OUT_FOR_DELIVERY', 'DELIVERED'] before generating URL

❌ TRAP: Storing S3 key without HEAD verification → false confirmation possible (INV-S5-10)
   FIX: ALWAYS call s3.headObject() before writing URL to DB

❌ TRAP: Not validating s3Key prefix → seller can confirm a key belonging to another seller (INV-S5-11)
   FIX: if (!s3Key.startsWith(`dispatch-proofs/${seller.businessId}/`)) → 403

❌ TRAP: Skipping MIME validation after HEAD → .exe or .zip stored as dispatch proof (INV-S5-35)
   FIX: Check headResult.ContentType against ALLOWED_MIME_TYPES before writing to DB
   ALLOWED: ['image/jpeg', 'image/png', 'image/webp', 'application/pdf']
   Anything else → 422 INVALID_FILE_TYPE

❌ TRAP: Using orderTracking.create() → duplicate constraint error on re-confirmation
   FIX: Use orderTracking.upsert() with { where: { orderId } } for idempotent confirmation

❌ TRAP: Streaming file through API server (memory pressure)
   FIX: Client uploads directly to S3 using pre-signed URL. API server never sees file bytes.
```

## §19 PHASE 6 — SELLER KPI ENGINE

**Objective:** Seller KPI dashboard with correct today's data, cached with Redis TTL 60s, with Redis bypass fallback. EXPLAIN ANALYZE gate before freeze.

**Model Recommended:** Gemini 2.5 Pro (indexing strategy is key — moderate complexity)

**Files Modified:**

- `apps/api/src/modules/seller/services/seller-kpi.service.ts` (from Phase 3)
- `apps/api/src/modules/seller/repositories/seller-kpi.repository.ts` (from Phase 3)
- `apps/api/src/modules/observability/metrics.providers.ts` — add `kpi_redis_bypass_total`

**Index Verification Gate (mandatory before freeze):**

```bash
# Run EXPLAIN ANALYZE on each KPI query against staging DB with >10K orders
# Must show Index Scan or Bitmap Index Scan — NOT Seq Scan

# Query 1: ordersToday
EXPLAIN ANALYZE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "Order"
WHERE "sellerId" = 'test-business-id'
  AND "createdAt" >= '2026-05-29 00:00:00'
  AND "isDeleted" = false;
# Expected: uses idx_order_seller_date (sellerId, createdAt)

# Query 2: pending orders
EXPLAIN ANALYZE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "Order"
WHERE "sellerId" = 'test-business-id'
  AND "status" IN ('PLACED', 'CONFIRMED', 'PROCESSING')
  AND "isDeleted" = false;
# Expected: uses idx_order_seller_stat (sellerId, status)

# Query 3: low stock
EXPLAIN ANALYZE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "Inventory"
WHERE "businessId" = 'test-business-id'
  AND "isLowStock" = true;
# Expected: uses idx_inv_biz_low (businessId, isLowStock)
```

**Acceptance Criteria:**

```
✅ GET /seller/dashboard/kpis → correct data for today's date
✅ ordersToday excludes orders from yesterday
✅ revenueToday excludes CANCELLED and PAYMENT_FAILED orders
✅ pendingOrderCount = PLACED + CONFIRMED + PROCESSING only
✅ Second GET within 60s → served from Redis (verify: TTL decreasing in Redis MONITOR)
✅ Redis SET for KPI cache: TTL is between 60 and 75 seconds (verify Redis TTL command) (INV-S5-36)
✅ EXPLAIN ANALYZE on all KPI queries → no Seq Scan
✅ Performance: GET /seller/dashboard/kpis < 200ms on staging with 10K orders
✅ Redis down → returns data, isCacheBypass: true, kpi_redis_bypass_total metric incremented
✅ Cache invalidated after new order created for this seller
✅ Seller A's KPI shows only Seller A's data (cross-seller leak test: verify with 2 sellers)
✅ pnpm build → zero errors
```

```
❌ TRAP: Using DATE("createdAt") = CURRENT_DATE in raw SQL → bypasses index (function on indexed column)
   FIX: Use WHERE "createdAt" >= TODAY_START AND "createdAt" < TOMORROW_START (range query uses index)

❌ TRAP: Single aggregate query with multiple JOINs instead of 4 independent queries
   FIX: 4 independent queries with Promise.all() — each hits its own index without JOIN overhead

❌ TRAP: Forgetting segment filter → returns cross-segment data (INV-S5-33)
```

## §20 PHASE 7 — SELLER SCORECARD ENGINE

**Objective:** Batch-computed seller scorecard. 6-hour cron. 3-metric composite score. Hinglish narratives. EventOutbox on score change.

**Model Recommended:** Claude Sonnet (scoring formula, anti-gaming, EventOutbox emission with dedup correctness)

**Files Created:**

- `apps/api/src/modules/seller/workers/seller-scorecard.worker.ts`
- `apps/api/src/modules/seller/services/seller-scorecard.service.ts`

**Scorecard Computation Formula:**

```typescript
// SellerScorecardWorker — processes businesses in chunks to control memory (Observation 3)
// CURRENT: processes all verified businesses in single pass (acceptable up to ~5K sellers)
// FUTURE SCALE: when seller count > 5K, chunk into batches of 500 (add MIGRATION S5-5 cursor)

// MANDATORY FILTER: Skip SUSPENDED businesses (INV-S5-40)
// Suspended sellers cannot ship orders, so their scorecard would be misleadingly low.
// Computing scores for suspended sellers is wasted compute and pollutes Sprint 7 Admin views.
const businesses = await this.prisma.business.findMany({
  where: {
    isDeleted: false,
    kycStatus: { not: 'SUSPENDED' }, // INV-S5-40: skip SUSPENDED
    // kycStatus: 'VERIFIED' recommended — but not blocking for MVP
  },
  select: { id: true, segment: true },
});

for (const business of businesses) {
  try {
    await this.computeScoreForBusiness(business.id, business.segment);
  } catch (err) {
    // Per-business failure MUST NOT abort the entire cron run
    this.logger.error({ businessId: business.id, error: err.message }, 'SCORECARD_COMPUTE_FAILED');
    // Continue to next business
  }
}

// Scorecard Computation — called per business
async computeScoreForBusiness(businessId: string, segment: Segment): Promise<void> {
  const windowStart = new Date(Date.now() - 90 * 24 * 3600 * 1000); // 90 days

  // AUDIT-S5-5: Fetch ONLY order IDs and status — avoid loading full order objects for 10K+ sellers
  // Loading full order payload for 500+ orders per seller = memory amplification risk
  // CORRECT: two-phase fetch — IDs + status first, then targeted queries for metric data
  const orders = await this.prisma.order.findMany({
    where: {
      sellerId: businessId,
      segment,
      createdAt: { gte: windowStart },
      isDeleted: false,
    },
    select: { id: true, status: true }, // MINIMAL select — never select: true or include: {}
    // FUTURE SCALE: add take: 1000 + cursor when seller volume grows beyond 1K orders/90-days
  });

  // MINIMUM SAMPLE SIZE (INV-S5-28)
  const completedOrders = orders.filter(o => ['SHIPPED', 'DELIVERED', 'COMPLETED'].includes(o.status));
  if (completedOrders.length < 5) {
    // Upsert with eligible: false — still stored so UI can show "Naya Seller" message
    await this.prisma.sellerScore.upsert({
      where: { businessId },
      create: { businessId, compositeScore: 0, orderCount: completedOrders.length, calculatedAt: new Date() },
      update: { orderCount: completedOrders.length, calculatedAt: new Date() },
    });
    return; // No EventOutbox — not enough data (INV-S5-18 implicitly — score is 0)
  }

  // METRIC 1: Dispatch Speed (40% weight)
  // % orders shipped within 48h of confirmedAt
  // Uses OrderStatusHistory timestamps — NOT self-reported (anti-gaming)
  const shippedHistory = await this.prisma.orderStatusHistory.findMany({
    where: { orderId: { in: completedOrders.map(o => o.id) }, statusTo: 'SHIPPED' },
  });
  const confirmedHistory = await this.prisma.orderStatusHistory.findMany({
    where: { orderId: { in: completedOrders.map(o => o.id) }, statusTo: 'CONFIRMED' },
  });
  // ... compute dispatchSpeedScore

  // METRIC 2: Delivery Quality (40% weight)
  // avg(SellerRating.deliverySpeed + productQuality) / 2
  const ratings = await this.prisma.sellerRating.findMany({
    where: { sellerId: businessId, createdAt: { gte: windowStart }, isDeleted: false },
  });
  // Fallback if ratings < 3: use dispatchSpeedScore alone (D6 decision)
  // ... compute deliveryQualityScore

  // METRIC 3: Acceptance Rate (20% weight)
  // % PLACED orders confirmed (not cancelled by seller)
  // ... compute acceptanceRate

  const compositeScore = Math.round(
    dispatchSpeedScore * 0.4 +
    deliveryQualityScore * 0.4 +
    acceptanceRate * 0.2
  );

  // Get previous score
  const existing = await this.prisma.sellerScore.findUnique({ where: { businessId } });

  // Upsert score
  await this.prisma.sellerScore.upsert({
    where: { businessId },
    create: {
      businessId, compositeScore, dispatchSpeedScore, deliveryQualityScore,
      acceptanceRate, orderCount: completedOrders.length, calculatedAt: new Date(),
      previousCompositeScore: null,
    },
    update: {
      previousCompositeScore: existing?.compositeScore ?? null,
      compositeScore, dispatchSpeedScore, deliveryQualityScore,
      acceptanceRate, orderCount: completedOrders.length, calculatedAt: new Date(),
    },
  });

  // Emit EventOutbox ONLY if score changed ≥1 point (INV-S5-18)
  const scoreDelta = Math.abs(compositeScore - (existing?.compositeScore ?? 0));
  if (scoreDelta >= 1 || existing === null) {
    const hour = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 13); // "2026-05-29T14" — deterministic (INV-17)
    await this.prisma.eventOutbox.create({
      data: {
        eventType: 'SupplierScoreUpdated',
        eventVersion: '1.0',           // INV-20
        schemaVersion: '5.0',          // INV-S5-23
        deduplicationKey: `supplier-score-updated-${businessId}-${hour}`,  // INV-S5-17
        payload: {
          businessId, compositeScore, dispatchSpeedScore, deliveryQualityScore,
          acceptanceRate, previousCompositeScore: existing?.compositeScore ?? null,
          calculatedAt: new Date().toISOString(), orderCount: completedOrders.length,
        },
        eventMonth: formatYearMonth(new Date()),
        status: 'PENDING',
      },
    });
  }
}
```

**Scorecard API:**

```typescript
// GET /seller/scorecard
interface SellerScoreResponseDto {
  eligible: boolean; // false if < 5 orders
  compositeScore: number; // 0-100
  dispatchSpeedScore: number;
  deliveryQualityScore: number;
  acceptanceRate: number;
  orderCount: number;
  calculatedAt: string;
  narrative: {
    // Hinglish explanation (INV-S5-28)
    dispatch: string;
    delivery: string;
    overall: string;
  };
  previousCompositeScore: number | null;
  scoreTrend: "UP" | "DOWN" | "STABLE" | null;
}
```

**Acceptance Criteria:**

```
✅ Seller with <5 completed orders → GET /seller/scorecard returns eligible: false, "Naya Seller..." message
✅ Seller with ≥5 orders → scorecard shows meaningful scores
✅ SellerScorecardWorker cron runs every 6 hours (verify BullMQ job count)
✅ No duplicate cron jobs on API restart 3 times (stable jobId: 'seller-scorecard-cron') (INV-S5-19)
✅ SellerScore.calculatedAt updated after each cron run
✅ EventOutbox: SupplierScoreUpdated emitted when score changes ≥1 point (INV-S5-18)
✅ EventOutbox: NOT emitted when score unchanged (INV-S5-18)
✅ EventOutbox deduplicationKey uses ISO hour — not Date.now() (INV-S5-17)
✅ seller_scorecard_run_total counter incremented after each cron run
✅ seller_scorecard_latency_ms histogram records cron duration
✅ Scorecard reads only OrderStatusHistory timestamps — NOT order.shippedAt self-reported field
✅ Suspended seller (kycStatus = SUSPENDED) is NOT included in scorecard computation (INV-S5-40)
✅ One business failing computeScoreForBusiness() does NOT abort the entire cron run
✅ pnpm build → zero errors
```

**AI Footguns:**

```
❌ TRAP: Using deduplicationKey: `supplier-score-updated-${businessId}-${Date.now()}` (INV-17, INV-S5-17)
   FIX: ISO hour: new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 13) → "2026-05-29T14"

❌ TRAP: Emitting SupplierScoreUpdated even when score unchanged → notification spam (INV-S5-18)
   FIX: Only emit if Math.abs(newScore - oldScore) >= 1

❌ TRAP: Adding cron job with jobId: undefined → duplicate jobs on restart (INV-S5-19)
   FIX: jobId: 'seller-scorecard-cron' — stable, deterministic string

❌ TRAP: Computing dispatch speed from order.shippedAt (self-reported, setter-controlled)
   FIX: Use OrderStatusHistory timestamps — statusTo = 'SHIPPED' timestamp is system-set

❌ TRAP: Computing scores for SUSPENDED businesses → misleading data + wasted compute (INV-S5-40)
   FIX: Filter businesses WHERE kycStatus != 'SUSPENDED' before scorecard loop

❌ TRAP: One business throwing uncaught exception aborts entire cron → remaining sellers unscored
   FIX: Wrap computeScoreForBusiness() in try/catch per business, log error, continue loop

❌ TRAP: Future scale — fetching all 50K businesses at once → OOM / DB overload
   FIX: Future migration: cursor-based chunking, 500 businesses per BullMQ child job
```

## §21 PHASE 8 — BUYER REORDER ENGINE

**Objective:** 1-tap reorder. Current prices, current inventory. Partial reorder allowed. ALL skipped items in warnings. Rate limited.

**Model Recommended:** Gemini 2.5 Pro (moderate complexity — price trap and warning completeness are key)

**Files Created:**

- `apps/api/src/modules/buyer/services/buyer-reorder.service.ts`
- `apps/api/src/modules/buyer/controllers/buyer-orders.controller.ts` — add reorder endpoint

**Complete Reorder Implementation (INV-S5-12, INV-S5-13, INV-S5-25, INV-S5-27):**

```typescript
@Injectable()
export class BuyerReorderService {
  async reorder(orderId: string, buyerId: string): Promise<ReorderResultDto> {
    // STEP 1: Rate limit (INV-S5-25) — 5 reorders per buyer per hour
    // CONSERVATIVE FAIL-SAFE (INV-S5-37): If Redis is unreachable, do NOT fail-open.
    // Unlimited reorder on Redis outage = abuse vector. Allow at most 1 through, then reject.
    const rateLimitKey = `reorder_rate:${buyerId}`;
    let rateLimitAllowed = false;
    try {
      const rateLimitResult = await this.redis.eval(
        RATE_LIMIT_LUA_SCRIPT, // atomic Lua (INV-21)
        [rateLimitKey],
        ["5", "3600"],
      );
      if (Number(rateLimitResult) > 5) {
        throw new TooManyRequestsException({
          code: "REORDER_RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED",
        });
      }
      rateLimitAllowed = true;
    } catch (err) {
      if (err instanceof TooManyRequestsException) throw err; // re-throw rate limit rejection

      // Redis unavailable — conservative policy: reject with 503 (INV-S5-37)
      // NEVER fail-open (allow unlimited) when rate limit cannot be verified
      this.logger.warn(
        { buyerId, error: err.message },
        "REORDER_RATE_LIMIT_REDIS_DOWN",
      );
      throw new ServiceUnavailableException({
        code: "RATE_LIMIT_UNAVAILABLE_TRY_LATER",
      });
    }

    // STEP 2: Load original order (with buyerId ownership check) (INV-18)
    const originalOrder = await this.buyerOrderRepo.findByIdForBuyer(
      orderId,
      buyerId,
    );
    const originalItems = await this.prisma.orderItem.findMany({
      where: { orderId },
      include: {
        product: {
          select: {
            id: true,
            basePrice: true,
            isActive: true,
            isDeleted: true,
            segment: true,
          },
        },
      },
    });

    const warnings: ReorderWarningDto[] = [];
    const itemsToAdd: Array<{
      productId: string;
      quantity: number;
      currentPrice: Decimal;
    }> = [];

    // STEP 3: Process each original item (INV-S5-12, INV-S5-13, INV-S5-27)
    for (const item of originalItems) {
      const product = item.product;

      // Check product availability
      if (!product || product.isDeleted || !product.isActive) {
        warnings.push({
          // INV-S5-13: NEVER silent
          type: "PRODUCT_UNAVAILABLE",
          productId: item.productId,
          productName: item.productName,
          reason: "Product no longer available",
        });
        continue;
      }

      // Check inventory via InventoryService (INV-S5-27)
      const availability = await this.inventoryService.getAvailability(
        item.productId,
        originalOrder.segment,
      );
      if (availability.availableQuantity < item.quantity) {
        warnings.push({
          // INV-S5-13: NEVER silent
          type: "OUT_OF_STOCK",
          productId: item.productId,
          productName: item.productName,
          reason: `Only ${availability.availableQuantity} units available`,
        });
        continue;
      }

      // CURRENT price — NEVER snapshot (INV-S5-12)
      const currentPrice = product.basePrice; // ← fresh from DB, NOT item.unitPrice
      const snapshotPrice = item.unitPrice;
      const priceDelta = currentPrice
        .minus(snapshotPrice)
        .abs()
        .div(snapshotPrice);

      if (priceDelta.greaterThan(0.1)) {
        // >10% change → warn (still add to cart)
        warnings.push({
          type: "PRICE_CHANGED",
          productId: item.productId,
          productName: item.productName,
          priceFrom: snapshotPrice.toString(),
          priceTo: currentPrice.toString(),
        });
      }

      itemsToAdd.push({
        productId: item.productId,
        quantity: item.quantity,
        currentPrice,
      });
    }

    // STEP 4: Add available items to NEW cart via CartService (not direct DB write)
    const cart = await this.cartService.findOrCreateCart(
      buyerId,
      originalOrder.segment,
    );
    for (const itemData of itemsToAdd) {
      await this.cartService.upsertItem(cart.id, buyerId, {
        productId: itemData.productId,
        quantity: itemData.quantity,
        // CartService uses current product price internally — this is a double-safety check
      });
    }

    // STEP 5: Metrics
    const outcome =
      itemsToAdd.length === 0
        ? "zero"
        : warnings.length > 0
          ? "partial"
          : "success";
    this.metrics.buyerReorderTotal.inc({
      segment: originalOrder.segment,
      outcome,
    });

    return {
      cartId: cart.id,
      addedCount: itemsToAdd.length,
      skippedCount: warnings.length,
      warnings, // INV-S5-13: ALL skipped items present here
    };
  }
}
```

**Acceptance Criteria:**

```
✅ POST /buyer/orders/:id/reorder (all items in stock) → cartId returned, addedCount = total items, warnings = []
✅ POST /buyer/orders/:id/reorder (1 item out of stock) → addedCount = N-1, warnings contains OUT_OF_STOCK item
✅ POST /buyer/orders/:id/reorder (product deactivated) → warnings contains PRODUCT_UNAVAILABLE, not added to cart
✅ POST /buyer/orders/:id/reorder (price changed >10%) → item added to cart, warnings contains PRICE_CHANGED
✅ POST /buyer/orders/:id/reorder (all out of stock) → addedCount = 0, all items in warnings (INV-S5-13)
✅ Cart uses CURRENT product.basePrice — NOT OrderItem.unitPrice snapshot (INV-S5-12)
  Verification: Change product price after order, then reorder — cart should have new price
✅ Rate limit: 6th reorder within 1h → 429 REORDER_RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED
✅ Buyer A cannot reorder Buyer B's order → 404
✅ buyer_reorder_total counter incremented with correct outcome label
✅ pnpm build → zero errors
```

**AI Footguns:**

```
❌ TRAP: Using item.unitPrice (OrderItem snapshot) for cart price → historical price used (INV-S5-12)
   FIX: Load product.basePrice fresh from DB. Never use OrderItem.unitPrice for reorder pricing.

❌ TRAP: Silently skipping out-of-stock items without adding to warnings → buyer unaware (INV-S5-13)
   FIX: Every skipped item MUST appear in warnings[]. No silent skips.

❌ TRAP: Calling prisma.inventory.findFirst() directly for stock check (INV-S5-27)
   FIX: Use inventoryService.getAvailability() — InventoryService is the sole inventory authority

❌ TRAP: Writing cart items directly to DB without CartService
   FIX: Use CartService.upsertItem() — maintains cart cache invalidation, cart business rules

❌ TRAP: Rate limit Redis.eval() without try/catch → Redis outage = unlimited reorders (INV-S5-37)
   FIX: Wrap Redis.eval() in try/catch. On Redis unavailable → throw 503 RATE_LIMIT_UNAVAILABLE_TRY_LATER
   NEVER silently allow unlimited access when rate limit cannot be verified
```

## §22 PHASE 9 — EVENTOUTBOX INTEGRATION

**Objective:** Verify all Sprint 5 EventOutbox events are correctly shaped, deduplicated, and compatible with Sprint 6 consumers.

**Model Recommended:** Gemini 2.5 Pro (pattern verification)

**Verification Checklist:**

```typescript
// Grep audit commands — run after implementation, before freeze

// 1. Verify schemaVersion on all Sprint 5 events (INV-S5-23)
grep -rn "eventOutbox.create" apps/api/src/modules/seller apps/api/src/modules/buyer --include="*.ts" \
  | grep -v "schemaVersion: '5.0'"
// Must return ZERO matches — all Sprint 5 outbox creates must have schemaVersion: '5.0'

// 2. Verify no Date.now() or randomUUID() in deduplicationKey (INV-17)
grep -rn "deduplicationKey" apps/api/src/modules/seller apps/api/src/modules/buyer --include="*.ts" \
  | grep -E "Date\.now\(\)|randomUUID\(\)|new Date\(\)"
// Must return ZERO matches

// 3. Verify eventOutbox.create inside $transaction for status transitions (INV-S5-8)
// Manual review of seller-order.service.ts — eventOutbox.create must be inside $transaction block

// 4. Verify NO eventOutbox.create in dispatch proof confirm handler (INV-S5-9)
grep -n "eventOutbox" apps/api/src/modules/seller/services/seller-order.service.ts \
  | grep -i "dispatch\|proof\|confirm"
// Must return ZERO matches
```

**EventOutbox Relay Inheritance (AUDIT-S5-6):**

> Sprint 5 does NOT create a new EventOutbox relay worker.
> The existing EventOutbox worker from Sprint 2/3 processes ALL PENDING events (including Sprint 5 events).
> Sprint 5 agent MUST NOT create a new `EventOutboxWorker` or `EventOutboxRelayWorker`.
> The relay worker polls `EventOutbox WHERE status = 'PENDING'` and dispatches to consumers.
> Sprint 5 events (schemaVersion '5.0') will be processed by this existing worker.
> Sprint 6 (Notifications) will add its own consumer for `OrderStatusChanged` and `SupplierScoreUpdated` event types.

**EventOutbox Sprint 6 Compatibility Verification:**

For each `OrderStatusChanged` event emitted in Sprint 5, Sprint 6 NotificationWorker needs:

- `payload.buyerId` → look up `User.phone` for SMS notification ✅ present
- `payload.sellerId` → look up seller's contact for notification ✅ present
- `payload.statusTo` → determine notification template ✅ present
- `payload.orderNumber` → human-readable order reference ✅ present
- `payload.trackingNumber` → include in "your order shipped" SMS ✅ present when statusTo=SHIPPED

**Acceptance Criteria:**

```
✅ grep verify: all Sprint 5 eventOutbox.create() have schemaVersion: '5.0'
✅ grep verify: no deduplicationKey uses Date.now() or randomUUID()
✅ grep verify: no eventOutbox.create in dispatch proof confirm path
✅ Unit test: OrderStatusChanged payload has all required fields for Sprint 6
✅ Unit test: SupplierScoreUpdated payload has compositeScore + previousCompositeScore
✅ DB verify: Sprint 5 EventOutbox events appear in PENDING status (existing relay worker picks them up)
✅ NO new EventOutboxWorker or EventOutboxRelayWorker created by Sprint 5 (grep verify)
✅ pnpm build → zero errors
```

**AI Footguns:**

```
❌ TRAP: Treating SupplierScoreUpdated as needing to be inside $transaction
   FIX: Scorecard computation is a read + upsert. EventOutbox for scorecard is outside any $transaction.

❌ TRAP: Using same schemaVersion '4.3' from Sprint 4 (INV-S5-23)
   FIX: All Sprint 5 events use schemaVersion: '5.0'

❌ TRAP: Creating a new EventOutboxRelayWorker or EventOutboxProcessor in Sprint 5 (AUDIT-S5-6)
   FIX: The existing relay worker from Sprint 2/3 already processes ALL PENDING EventOutbox records.
   Sprint 5 only CREATES EventOutbox records — it never consumes them.
   Sprint 6 adds consumers. Do NOT create a new relay worker.
```

```
REQUIRED FOR THIS PHASE:

  1. Seller ownership uses Business.id (from SellerContextGuard, req.seller.businessId). NEVER User.id. (INV-S5-1)
```

### §28.7 Self-Hardening Findings Integrated

During self-audit and enterprise hardening review, the following issues were identified and integrated into the architecture:

**Original self-audit findings (v1.0):**

1. **SellerContextGuard Redis bypass needed**: Guard itself needs Redis bypass (not just KPI). Integrated in §9.1.
2. **Dispatch proof status gate**: Upload-url endpoint must validate order is SHIPPED+ (not PLACED/CONFIRMED). Integrated in §18.
3. **Reorder InventoryService path**: BuyerReorderService must use `inventoryService.getAvailability()` — not direct Prisma query. Integrated in §21 (INV-S5-27).
4. **SellerScore index for Admin**: Added `idx_seller_score_composite` index for Sprint 7 "worst sellers" query. Integrated in §3.1.
5. **historyMonth on OrderStatusHistory**: Sprint 5 transition creates must populate `historyMonth` partition key — same as `orderMonth` in Order. Integrated in §17.
6. **Segment filter on all scorecard queries**: Scorecard queries must include `segment` to support multi-segment sellers. Integrated in §20 (INV-S5-33).
7. **Buyer cancel SHIPPED → meaningful error**: Error code `ORDER_TOO_FAR_IN_FULFILLMENT` is more actionable than generic 422. Integrated in §15.
8. **Reorder rate limit uses atomic Lua**: INV-21 applies to reorder_rate key — not just cart/checkout rate limits. Integrated in §21 (INV-S5-25).

**Hardening review additions (v1.1):**

9. **Inventory release on buyer cancel missing**: `cancelOrder()` had `// AFTER tx: release inventory` comment with no implementation. Full `InventoryService.releaseAllForOrder()` pattern added with CRITICAL logging on failure. Added as INV-S5-34, INV-S5-41. Integrated in §15.
10. **S3 MIME type not validated at confirm**: `headObject()` result was used only for existence check. Content-Type MIME validation against allowlist added (JPEG, PNG, WebP, PDF). Added as INV-S5-35. Integrated in §18 and §9.4.
11. **KPI cache stampede under concurrent sellers**: Flat 60s TTL causes all sellers with simultaneously expired caches to hit DB at once. Jitter TTL (60–75s) added. Added as INV-S5-36. Integrated in §5, §16, §19.
12. **Reorder rate limit fail-open on Redis down**: Original `await this.redis.eval(...)` without try/catch means Redis outage = unlimited reorders. Conservative 503 fail-safe added. Added as INV-S5-37. Integrated in §21.
13. **STATUS_TIMESTAMP_FIELD_MAP undefined**: Field map was referenced in `transitionStatus()` but never defined. Explicit constant added. Added as INV-S5-38. Integrated in §4.0.
14. **$transaction timeout missing**: Sprint 3 §3.4 requires `{ timeout: 5000 }` on all transactions. All Sprint 5 transactions now include it. Added as INV-S5-39. Integrated in §4.1, §15.
15. **Scorecard runs for SUSPENDED sellers**: Wasted compute + misleading Admin data. Business filter `kycStatus != SUSPENDED` added to cron fetch. Added as INV-S5-40. Integrated in §20.
16. **Per-business scorecard failure aborts cron**: Single business exception terminating entire run. Per-business try/catch added. Integrated in §20.
17. **Confirm re-entrant creates duplicate OrderTracking**: `orderTracking.create()` on repeat confirm throws unique constraint error. Changed to `upsert()` for idempotency. Integrated in §18.

**Final Audit findings (v1.2):**

18. **S3 presigned URL Conditions missing pdf MIME**: `['starts-with', '$Content-Type', 'image/']` condition excluded `application/pdf` and allowed `image/gif`, `image/tiff` etc. Replaced with explicit per-type conditions. (AUDIT-S5-1). Integrated in §9.4.
19. **releaseAllForOrder() called with 2 args, contract requires 3**: Sprint 3 public interface is `releaseAllForOrder(orderId, reason: ReleaseReason, actorId)`. Sprint 5 code called it with `(orderId, buyerId)` — compile error. Fixed to `(orderId, 'ORDER_CANCELLED', buyerId)`. (AUDIT-S5-2). Integrated in §15.
20. **STATUS_TIMESTAMP_MAP vs STATUS_TIMESTAMP_FIELD_MAP naming inconsistency**: `transitionStatus()` referenced `STATUS_TIMESTAMP_MAP` which does not exist — compile error. Corrected to `STATUS_TIMESTAMP_FIELD_MAP` matching the §4.0 constant. (AUDIT-S5-3). Integrated in §17.
21. **Missing security alerts**: `seller_scorecard_dlq_size > 0` and S3 key ownership violation surge had no alerts. Added to §11.2 alert table.
22. **Scorecard order fetch loads full object payload**: `findMany` with no `select` loads all columns for all orders — N-column amplification for high-volume sellers. Fixed to `select: { id: true, status: true }` for the initial fetch. (AUDIT-S5-5). Integrated in §20.
23. **EventOutbox relay inheritance not stated**: Sprint 5 is silent on which worker processes PENDING events. Clarified: existing Sprint 2/3 relay worker handles all PENDING records. Sprint 5 does NOT create a new relay worker. (AUDIT-S5-6). Integrated in §22.

### §30.2 Security Findings

| Finding                                                     | Risk                                                                                                               | Resolution                                                                               |
| ----------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| S3 Conditions `image/*` wildcard                            | Attacker uploads `image/gif` (potentially executable EXIF exploit) or `application/pdf` bypass if wildcard matched | ✅ Fixed: explicit MIME per condition                                                    |
| Cross-seller dispatch proof upload                          | Seller A submits Seller B's s3Key at confirm endpoint                                                              | ✅ Mitigated: prefix check `dispatch-proofs/{businessId}/` (INV-S5-11)                   |
| Buyer impersonation via Buyer A reordering Buyer B's orders | Horizontal privilege escalation in reorder                                                                         | ✅ Mitigated: `findByIdForBuyer(orderId, buyerId)`                                       |
| Seller accessing buyer PII                                  | Seller sees buyer phone/email                                                                                      | ✅ Mitigated: `buyerCode` masking, never raw `buyerId` in SellerOrderDto                 |
| Redis rate limit fail-open                                  | Redis outage = unlimited reorders per buyer                                                                        | ✅ Mitigated: conservative 503 fail-safe (INV-S5-37)                                     |
| **Non-blocking note**: Buyer suspension not checked         | A buyer with `isDeleted=true` can still call buyer APIs                                                            | ⚠️ Non-blocking: Sprint 6 adds `BuyerContextGuard`. Current Sprint relies on JWT expiry. |

| Scorecard `IN` clause for 500+ orderIds | `WHERE orderId IN (...)` with 500+ values may not use index | ⚠️ Non-blocking: acceptable at MVP scale. Sprint 9 materializes. |
| KPI cache stampede                      | All sellers expire together → DB spike                      | ✅ Mitigated: jitter TTL (INV-S5-36)                             |
| Scorecard for 50K+ sellers              | Single findMany loads all businesses                        | ✅ Documented: future cursor-chunking in §20 footguns            |
| SellerContextGuard on every request     | DB lookup on every seller route                             | ✅ Mitigated: Redis 60s cache                                    |
